_meta.note: league_data_mode: decayed/tier-weighted picks & bans from actual tracked tournament matches (h2h_matches.json + supplementary_matches.json), split by team. bans_against[hero] = how often opponents ban that hero specifically against this team, broken down by which opponent did it (by_opponent). player_history_mode: independent rollup of each team's 5 players' most-recent hero history (player_recent_heroes.json) - reflects individual comfort picks, not necessarily what shows up in the team's actual tournament drafts.
